Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — really helpful. A quick recap from our side and the priorities we want to validate in the eval run:

- Use cases: customer-facing chat summarization (short summaries), search reranking for product search, and entity extraction/localization for EU languages.
- Languages of interest: DE, FR, ES, IT (EU); JA, KO (APAC); fallback to EN when needed.
- Success criteria: precision/recall for NER (>0.87 across EU languages), summary ROUGE-L baseline we shared, and rerank MRR improvement vs. current Elastic setup.

Can you share the recommended model variants for these workloads, the benchmark sheet you mentioned, and the prompt sets we should run? Also flagged: we need to watch for quality regressions when using quantized variants for the EU languages.

Next steps on our side: provision a 48h eval window and provide a 5k-sample multilingual set (we have prepared sample export; will share via SFTP).

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Müller | Head of AI Platforms, Globex Retail

Subject: Re: Post-call: Model fit & multilingual evals (EU/APAC) - next steps

Hi Sophie — great to sync. Quick post-call recap and concrete next steps (TL;DR at the top).

TL;DR
- Recommended model candidates: rw-infer-13b (float16), rw-infer-7b-q4 with locale-aware prompt templates, and a distilled reranker (rw-rank-1.4b) for cost-sensitive paths.
- Deliverables from Redwood: benchmark spreadsheet (link below), the MAPS prompt set (attached), and an eval run plan + canary rollout template.
- Next steps: Globex to upload sample data to SFTP; Redwood to provision a 48h eval (dedicated) and run the MAPS prompts; schedule a 30-min sync after results.

Model recommendations and rationale:
1) rw-infer-13b (fp16) — best balance of quality vs latency for summarization in EU languages; recommended for primary eval.
2) rw-infer-7b-q4 — strong cost-performance for chat + rerank when latency is <150ms requirement; validate for EN + JA fallback.
3) rw-rank-1.4b — cheaper reranker that can be used as a two-stage pipeline (cheap rerank -> expensive re-rank top-k).

Locale and eval notes:
- EU languages (DE/FR/ES/IT): run both full-context NER prompts and shorter in-line prompts to capture tokenization impacts.
- APAC (JA/KO): include character-level tokenization checks and a small synthetic set for polite/formal language markers.
- Quantization/regression risk: we recommend running the 7b-q4 variant in parallel with fp16 for a 2k-sample A/B to detect regressions; look for per-lang precision drop >3 points as a trigger to avoid quantized path.

Attached: MAPS_prompt_set_v2.json (prompt templates + eval harness commands).
Benchmark link:
https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/1abcDEF-model-eval-report

Operational items:
- Redwood will spin up a dedicated eval pool for 48 hours (estimate: 6 GPUs) — no cost for this PoC, but usage will be monitored.
- We will capture token-level latency & cost breakdowns and attach per-language quality metrics in the spreadsheet.

Proposed schedule:
- Wed 4 Mar: Globex upload sample to SFTP by 10:00 CET
- Thu 5 Mar: Redwood runs evals (start 02:00 UTC) 
- Fri 6 Mar: 30-min sync (results review) — propose 14:00 CET

Let me know if that works and if there are any security controls we need to pre-clear (SFTP host keys, IP allowlist, or SOC2 evidence request).

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Hey Sophie / Neha — attaching the MAPS prompt set and a quick runbook. Highlights from the SE side: 

- Attachment: MAPS_prompt_set_v2.json (contains prompt templates, per-lang tokenization notes, scoring mapping).
- Attachment: multilingual-benchmarks-v1.csv (sample expected schema + gold labels).
- Eval plan: 1) sanity pass (200 samples per lang) -> 2) full run (2k per lang) -> 3) A/B 7b-q4 vs 13b-fp16 on the top failing slices.

Quality/regression checks to include in run:
- Per-lang precision/recall for entities (NER), and threshold check where drop >3 absolute points vs baseline triggers auto-fallback to fp16.
- Tokenization mismatch detection: flag if average token length delta > 10% vs baseline for JA/KO.
- Rerank MRR: measure overall and by category (electronics, apparel, home).

Security/operational notes:
- We will provide an SFTP endpoint and one-time signed URL for the sample set. We will not store samples beyond 30 days for the PoC; full retention policy can be scoped under Private deployment.
